# YT Lab

> YT Lab develops and operates mobile games, including Football Career Sim.

## Football Career Sim

English: Football Career Sim: Be a Pro / Football Career Sim.
한국어: 축구선수 키우기.
简体中文: 绿茵人生：足球员养成模拟 / 绿茵人生.
繁體中文: 綠茵人生：足球員養成模擬 / 綠茵人生.

Develop a youth football player from age seventeen through retirement.
Choose Growth Cards to shape the player's development and career.
Progress through matches, transfers, contract renewals and national-team opportunities.
Retired players become the squad of your club in the Weekly League, a separate online mode with promotion and relegation.
A free browser trial covers the first five seasons of the same game.
Career simulation works offline; rankings, purchases, wallet and device transfers require a network connection.

Platforms: iPhone and iPad (iOS 15 or later), Android 7.0 or later. Free to download, with optional in-app purchases.

- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6807107830): iOS download.
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=site.ytlab.soccer_career): Android download.
